title: PR Reconciliation Ledger Row
description: Schema for one row in the PR reconciliation ledger. Each row represents one PR or issue evaluated during a reconciliation wave. Generated output goes to target/reconciliation/ — never committed.

pr.description: PR or issue number as a positive integer.

canonical_repo.description: The authoritative repository for this change (slug). May differ from repo when a fix originated upstream.

evidence.description: List of evidence artifacts supporting the classification. Each entry is a human-readable string (e.g. merge commit SHA, CI run URL, reachability output). Must be non-empty.

required_action.description: The concrete next action required (e.g. 'merge', 'open port-PR against main', 'close with proof comment', 'no action').

validation.description: Command or check that confirms the required_action is complete (e.g. 'gh pr view NNN --json state', 'cargo test -p crate').

close_proof.description: Required when classification is 'close-superseded'. Contains the git merge-base reachability output proving the superseding commit is in main ancestry.

command.description: The exact command run: git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main && echo ANCESTOR || echo NOT ANCESTOR

output.description: Verbatim stdout of the command. Must be 'ANCESTOR' for a valid close.

verified_date.description: ISO 8601 date the proof was captured (YYYY-MM-DD).

sync_direction.description: Which direction the change must flow: swarm->source (swarm change must be ported upstream), source->swarm (upstream fix must come in), or none (no sync required).

evidence: Superseded by merge commit abc1234 in PR #1100

close_proof.command: git merge-base --is-ancestor abc1234 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR || echo NOT ANCESTOR
